NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby order and decree as part of the law of the land as follows:
Section 1. Any person who, without express or implied permission or authority of the base commander or
his duly authorized representatives, shall re-enter or is found within any military base after having been
removed therefrom and ordered not to re-enter by the base commander or his duly authorized representative,
shall be punished for the first offense, with imprisonment of not more than ten (10) days or a fine not
exceeding P100.00, or both; for the second offense, with imprisonment of not less than ten (10) days but not
more than one (1) month or a fine of not less than P100.00 but not more than P200.00, or both; and for the
third and subsequent offenses, with imprisonment of not less than one (1) month but not more than six (6)
months or a fine of not less than P200.00 but not more than P1,000.00, or both.
Section 2. The term "military base" as used in this decree means any military, air, naval, or coast guard
reservation, base, fort, camp, arsenal, yard, station, or installation in the Philippines.
Section 3. Nothing in this decree shall be construed to deny any person ingress to or egress from his
privately-owned land embraced, located or situated within any military base mentioned in Sections 1 and 2
Section 4. This decree shall take effect thirty days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a
newspaper of general circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of October, in the year of Our lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
